meta.parties: Muttucarpen Chettiar v. Mohamed Salim Et Al

rules.statement: A party to an application under the Appellate Procedure (Privy Council) Order, 1921, unless he appears in person, must file a document in writing appointing a Proctor of the Supreme Court to act for him in connection therewith. This does not require that the proxy be signed by the party himself but can be done through his lawfully appointed attorney.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think these words can be read into the rule. I think the words in the rule imply nothing more than 'a document which appoints a Proctor'-a loose but sufficiently precise phrase."
